hold_text: BREAKOUT-ATTRITION: two changes to the live prop executor's order path (src/prop/prop_executor.py), dispatched as HELD PRs; the manager has them independently reviewed and merges under the standing data-backed authorization. (2) A resting entry limit whose ticket's valid_until has passed is cancelled once (only the matched working orders, only when the ledger row carries valid_until, never a filled position). Deliberately NOT armed: an automerge-request file would land it.
why: Stops the executor falsifying manual ETH tickets as skipped and stops an unfilled SOL limit resting past its ticket's validity, where it held the symbol and blocked every same-direction reticket with no time window.
